_provider.notes: Single speaker, single recording environment, purpose-recorded for phonics instruction. Chosen because it is the same source that produced the approved s/a/t/p/i/n assets.

_note: approvalStatus is NEVER set here. Every asset ships UNREVIEWED and must be listened to by a parent in Parent > Sound Library. The app binds approval to sha256, so untouched files keep their approval.
